residualFreeze.remainingHighImpactDefinition: residuals tagged consequence=offscreen across the two audited sites (linear 1017 + hobbang 536). `clipping` is 0 by construction because `offscreen` is tested first and wins the tag.
residualFreeze.keyFinding: The residual is an ANCESTOR-CHAIN property. 6 of 10 linear leaders and 8 of hobbang's carry a truth-check-VERIFIED full-width rule and still measure a constant clone width, because the box they resolve against is frozen. Refusing more is not the fix and neither is emitting more on the leaves.
residualFreeze.artifactLimitation: Per-route retention is 24 and the ranking's first key is the offscreen tag, so retained records are 100% offscreen while detected populations are 34% (linear) / 24% (hobbang). The family histogram cannot be recomputed from the artifact.

gridRecovery.ruleCountCaveat: gridTrackColumns series on linear across this wave: 76 (pre-wave) -> 80 (B2 runs) -> 84 (gate run) -> 75 (FINAL GRADED run). The +4 reported in report 03 is NOT present in the reconstruction that produced the verdicts. The refusal-class elimination IS present in every post-B2 run including the graded one.

qaHonesty.guardsCaveat: All demotion counters are 0 on all four final canary runs. The guards are fixture-verified, not corpus-verified; no count change in this wave may be credited to them.
openDefects: L1 — classifyOverlapPair checks failed-image-layer FIRST and demotes on EITHER leaf failing to load, so a real collapse onto a broken image is demoted from BLOCKER-capable overlap-excess-ratio to MAJOR-only image-layer-state. overlap-excess-ratio-undemoted is recorded but no channel fires on it. Blast radius on this wave's reported numbers is provably zero (all demotion counters 0).

L3 — gatePixels() computes over min(source,clone) width and height, and captures are fullPage, so the horizontal overflow band the frozen-width defect produces is never pixel-diffed and the review pack shows different-width images side by side without saying so.

responsiveVariant.gateEvidence: Fresh run: clone scrollHeight byte-identical at 390/700/1024 (5876) and again at 1100/1440 (9960) — two states, no continuum — while the source varies continuously. `/` changes DOM family between 390 and 700; `/pricing` between 1024 and 1100.
responsiveVariant.signal: rendered boxes (getClientRects().length > 0) + depth-6 FNV-1a structure hash. NOT node population, which is flat on sites that ship both variants and swap with display — proved by mutation.
responsiveVariant.measuredEffect: linear `/` clone visible nodes 700 1001->2511, 1024 991->2784; scrollHeight 5876->9960 at both; every tree-selection channel disappeared from those pairs; missing-text-ratio 0.4915->0.1071 (700) and 0.5425->0.0774 (1024).
responsiveVariant.hardLimit: Only two DOM trees are ever observed. Per-route switching relocates the swap; it cannot invent a third variant. Records variant-tree-not-observed-at-<width> rather than silently serving the 390 tree.
